title: What is the average number of badges obtained by a user with over 200 views
question: What is the average number of badges obtained by a user with over 200 views?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT AVG(badge_count)
FROM (
  SELECT bu.UserId, COUNT(*) AS badge_count
  FROM badges_users AS bu
  WHERE bu.Views > 200
  GROUP BY bu.UserId
)
